ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:9 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black background with scattered circular white clusters. A significant horizontal white rectangular band is mapped to the medial-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 75 degrees and a pixel-depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Variable serration frequency; right lobe exhibits larger, irregular peaks (valleys up to 10 pixels deep), while the left lobe shows high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curves sweeping upward and outward to acute points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast pixels concentrated at the lateral tips and scattered throughout the ventral field, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) across both lobes, with visible parallel rake marks on the lower sections of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of acorn barnacles present on both the left and right distal tips and sporadically along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique horizontal white linear scar or pigment mark on the inner left lobe proximal to the median notch.
